title: In characteristics two and three, a bounded function with large Gowers U4 norm correlates quantitatively with a cubic phase, allowing a nonclassical cubic in characteristic two
author: Jonathan Tidor
difficulty_reason: Even after the precise quantitative triaffine-correlation theorem, polynomial normal form, analytic/partition rank comparison and terminal U3 inverse theorem, the author must integrate non-classical multilinear forms by a full coefficient classification and build characteristic-specific symmetry corrections. A new diagonal bilinear defect argument in characteristic two and controlled subspace extensions preserve quantitative rank losses. The final Fourier conditioning, quadratic corrections and eight-phase cube remove those defects with explicit losses, leaving a sustained nonroutine argument beyond ordinary qualification Fourier analysis; the complete selected outcome is conservatively H2.
